dedupe_keys.name: raw snr data for manuscript gps interferometric reflectometry using a low cost antenna to measure water levels

description: Simon Williams and colleagues at the National Oceanography Centre publish GPS L1 signal-to-noise measurements for low-cost water-level sensing at the RNLI lifeboat station in Sligo, Ireland. The Zenodo deposit is free under CC BY 4.0 and covers observations in 2018 and 2019 from two SirfStar IV receiver arrangements mounted about sixteen metres above sea level. Daily gzip files use fixed-width columns for satellite identifier, elevation, azimuth, seconds of day, elevation-rate correction and L1 signal-to-noise ratio in dB-Hz. These observations can calibrate GNSS reflectometry used to monitor coastal water levels in flood simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these raw measurements. Reserved L2 and L5 columns are blank. Exact date completeness, sampling interval and height datum remain unknown, and the files do not themselves provide a processed water-level series. Receiver changes must be considered before combining years. No observation files were downloaded or reflectometry inversion performed.
